messages:
Priya R: Heads-up — nightly CI SAST job failed after yesterday's RBAC change, looks like keystore perms are the culprit. error in pipeline: `keystore: access denied` :eyes:
Jorge L: Which pipeline/service account?
Priya R: infra/deploy (gha). scanner SA = scanner@redwood-prod. Logs: ```ERROR scanner: decrypt failed: permission denied
resource: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/ci-keys/cryptoKeys/build-key
principal: serviceAccount:scanner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com```
Alex M: That exact failure usually means the SA lost roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter on that cryptoKey or the keyRing. Did we change any bindings in the infra change?
Priya R: Yeah, we removed a broad group binding and replaced w/ a narrower role yesterday — maybe scanner got dropped. Change PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/commit/ab12cd
Jorge L: If we need a quick unblock, add an ephemeral binding for the scanner SA for 1h via gcloud iam policy binding. eg: 
```bash
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding build-key \
  --location global --keyring ci-keys \
  --member serviceAccount:scanner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```
Alex M: Or use short-lived impersonation via workload identity if pipeline supports it. But ephemeral binding + audit entry is fastest. Make sure to add the justification in the audit log. :lock:
SecurityBot: Incident created INC-2026-214 for tracking (owner: eng-security). Link: https://incident.redwood/in/INC-2026-214
Sam T: FYI, if we re-grant, confirm that SAST artifacts don't leak plaintext keys — scanner only needs decrypt for test fixtures, should be scoped. Also add a test in preflight to catch this regression.
Priya R: I'll do the ephemeral grant now and open a PR to add a gating test. Will tag eng-security in PR.
Jorge L: Also audit why the role removal happened — add a blameless postmortem in the incident ticket. Could be our policy sync bot removed the group binding.
Alex M: One more ops note — if this keeps recurring, we should move the scanner to a dedicated key with a narrowly-scoped IAM binding and rotation policy.
Priya R: Done — ephemeral binding applied at 1717723800, CI retriggered and SAST passed. Adding checklist item to incident. Thanks all :thumbsup:
